subject: Invite link truncated on Outlook Mobile - AlturaSupply
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: support@zip-onboarding.com, alturasupply.ops@alturasupply.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Invite link truncated on Outlook Mobile - AlturaSupply

Hi team,

AlturaSupply (accounts+altura@alturasupply.com) reports they cannot complete their supplier profile: the invite link in our ZIP email is getting truncated on Outlook Mobile and tablet clients, producing a 404 / token-mismatch when they tap it. I attached a screenshot showing the link split across lines and the original .eml we received.

What I've looked at so far:
- The invite URL contains long query params and a plus in the recipient (accounts+altura@...).
- Outlook mobile appears to soft-wrap URLs at ~76 chars and inserts a line break, which some clients remove when opening the link.
- Altura says they never see the full token and can't complete the step to accept T&Cs and upload W-9.

Can Zip Support confirm: do you observe our invite template emitting any HTML entities (e.g. &) or extra whitespace? Can you re-issue a short link that will work even if a client breaks the message? Altura has a PO in three days and needs the tax profile set up before we can issue payment.

Please re-issue a short (non-wrapping) invite and copy me and Ben. If you need the user-agent string or device snapshot from Altura, I can get it.

Attachments: invite-screenshot.png (mobile), original-invite.eml

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Senior Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127
From: Zip Onboarding Support <support@zip-onboarding.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, alturasupply.ops@alturasupply.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite link truncated on Outlook Mobile - AlturaSupply

Thanks Naomi — we see this pattern occasionally.

Quick notes from our side:
- The token itself is URL-safe; we do not encode plus signs as spaces, but certain mobile clients will fold long anchor hrefs in the rendered HTML and the copy-to-clipboard flow sometimes drops the trailing fragment.
- Your invite template currently embeds the full URL inline with UTM query params and a long token; that increases the chance of soft-wrapping.

What we'll do now:
1) Issue a short redirect invite for accounts+altura@alturasupply.com that uses our short domain (one-time redirect). Attached: reissued-invite-shortlink.txt (short URL).
2) Create a fallback magic code that can be manually entered on the accept page if the link is broken.
3) Open ticket INC-8421 to investigate updating templates to include a visible long URL on a single line and a QR code option.

Can you confirm the exact recipient address you used (full envelope: accounts+altura@alturasupply.com) and whether Altura is opening the message in Outlook iOS/Android or Outlook Web? We only saw mobile wrapping in iOS so far.

Regards,
Maya K. (Tier 2)
Zip Onboarding Support
support@zip-onboarding.com

[Attachment: reissued-invite-shortlink.txt]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invite link truncated on Outlook Mobile - AlturaSupply

Ben / Monica — forwarding Zip's response. Key points and proposed next steps inline.

> From: Zip Onboarding Support <support@zip-onboarding.com>
> Can you confirm the exact recipient address you used (full envelope: accounts+altura@alturasupply.com) and whether Altura is opening the message in Outlook iOS/Android or Outlook Web?

We did use accounts+altura@alturasupply.com — the plus address is intentional (we tag vendors). Altura says Outlook iOS 16.4 and Outlook Android 8.0.0.

Immediate workaround suggestions I propose:
- Ask Product to change the invite flow to issue a short redirect by default for recipients with plus addressing or very long tokens. This matches Zip's shortlink option.
- For the immediate customer-facing action, Ben — can you approve a one-off shortlink reissue and a manual entry code so Altura can finish setup today?
- Longer-term: switch template to include both a short CTA button and a visible short link + QR in the fallback area (so mobile clients can scan).

Why this matters: Altura already has an approved PO (#ALT-4881) pending tax info; if we don't get them into the portal today they will miss this week's run and delay payment.

Let me know and I'll coordinate the re-send + confirm when Altura can try again.

—Naomi
